Bulk QR Code Generator

Turn a list of links, product pages or text into a set of QR codes in one go. Paste one item per line, choose the image size and error correction level, then download all the PNG files together as a ZIP.

How to use Bulk QR Code Generator

  1. Paste your links or text, one per line.
  2. Choose the image size and error correction (Medium is a good default).
  3. Click Preview to check a few codes.
  4. Download all QR codes as a ZIP.

Frequently asked questions

How many QR codes can I create?

Up to 300 per batch.

Which error correction level should I pick?

Medium suits most uses. Choose High if you plan to put a logo over the code or print on rough surfaces.

Do the QR codes expire?

No. These are static QR codes that contain your text directly, so they work forever and need no account.

Is my list uploaded?

No. Everything is generated in your browser.
